vb_textbox.text: The values of each gnome change regularly.  I found the purple and red gnomes seemed to give me more points but as soon as the dropped to 4 mushrooms or below, I changed to a different colour gnome and stuck with that for 2 goes.  If the number of mushrooms didn't go higher, I would then go back to picking the purple or red gnome.  Be quick and try not to over think it.
